cases.input: Here is a CSV of 412 support tickets from the last 90 days with subject, first message, resolution and minutes to resolve. Customers keep asking the same things. What should we write first?
cases.pass_criteria: Clusters by cause with ticket counts and median handling time, ranks by minutes saved, picks five to eight, and titles each in the customer's phrasing.
One message asking for the ticket export, product behaviour, platform, support team's top ten, tone and policy boundaries; offers the article structure and the lint pass while waiting.

cases.input: Publish these five articles to our help centre and check the zero-result searches from last month.
cases.pass_criteria: Names the help centre platform as the gap, delivers lint-clean drafts ready to paste, and states plainly that nothing was published and no search report was read.

cases.input: A customer has emailed asking where their refund is. Write the reply.

must_include_any: not for replying to one customer
must_not: here is the reply to send

cases.pass_criteria: Routes the reply to support-agent, and keeps the reusable part: whether this question deserves an article and what its title would be.

cases.input: Our help articles should rank on Google for 'how to file GSTR-3B' and bring us traffic.
cases.pass_criteria: Separates help-centre search from Google search intent, hands the commercial page to seo-specialist, and keeps only the support-intent article here.
